id: title:haacked:limit how long the replica override upsert waits on a lock

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the upsert path to use a transaction, allowing statement_timeout and lock_timeout to apply to the whole transaction rather than individual statements, and explicitly committing the transaction. This could help avoid statement-timeouts and clarify transaction boundaries, but does not demonstrate recovery or broader systemic benefit.
review.reason: Adds transaction and explicit commit; moves FK check and lock-timeout settings into transaction; removes direct execute on conn, uses tx instead; adds explicit commit.
review.uncertainty: While the implementation of transactional boundaries and explicit commits is visible, the actual benefit regarding statement timeout avoidance or recovery behavior is not demonstrated by execution or test results in the provided observations. The tier is assigned based on the implementation of a bounded correctness improvement, not unverified systemic benefits.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are supported. No tier assigned.
